featured_reviews.name: jass tha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly disgusted by the blatant discrimination and unprofessionalism at this branch!
I visited the Borivali West branch (located next to the Mufti outlet) today simply because I trusted the Tata brand name. Tata stands for trust, respect, and equality, but employees like the one I encountered today—a salesman named Nitul—are completely ruining the brand's hard-earned reputation.
When I entered, he was attending to a customer, so I patiently waited for 20 to 30 minutes. What makes it infuriating is that after ignoring me all that time to focus entirely on her, he failed to convince her and she just walked away. The moment she left, another girl walked into the store. Instead of attending to me—even though I had been waiting for half an hour—this salesman completely ignored me again and rushed to serve the new girl.
It is clear that the staff here judges customers entirely based on their clothes. They prioritize people wearing trendy outfits over those who prefer to dress simply. Dressing simply is my personal choice, and it does not give anyone the right to look down on me or make me wait. I was already sweating and in a rush because of urgent bank work, yet I was treated like I was completely invisible.
To make matters worse, when he finally did my eye checkup, it was an absolute joke. He used outdated technology and carelessly finished the whole thing in just 2 minutes. On top of that, he didn't even give me the detailed description or proper prescription of my eye checkup. Because he withheld these details, I cannot even confirm the readings with a doctor to get my glasses made in the proper way.
People visit Titan because they trust the Tata name, but staff like Nitul are dragging it through the mud. He is completely unfit to work in a reputable showroom. If you want to be treated with basic respect regardless of what you wear, avoid this branch. I strongly demand that management takes strict action against this behavior.
